title: Top product already held -- system quietly pivots to the next best eligible product

utterances.text: Thanks for calling, this is Noah -- how can I help today?
Hi, I keep getting emails about a savings account with better interest. Can I get that?
Let me check what you already have and what else might fit.
Looks like you actually already opened that one a while back -- it's already on your account.
Oh really? I had no idea, I don't think I've ever used it.
That happens more than you'd think. Would you like me to check if there's anything else worth looking at instead?
Sure, I travel a fair bit for work, if that helps.
Noted -- let me see what fits a frequent traveller on your account.
Here's what I'd suggest based on your account.
Sounds reasonable, thank you for checking.
Of course -- thanks for calling, have a great day!
